column1: # doc pdhd/12 -- ANSWER KEY for the pdvd STM + Michel scan.
# Committed on purpose: it is the record of the sample at arm d15vnu /
# HEAD c0b1613b, and a scan whose key lives only beside a work/ arm stops
# being scorable the day that arm is retired.
# THE BLIND ON THIS FILE IS AN HONOUR RULE, NOT A STRUCTURAL ONE, and doc
# pdhd/12 sec 6 says so.  What IS structural is the display: the viewer
# never opens this file, and the chain's answer reaches no data source
# unless REVEAL is on -- proved by poisoning it.  Do not open this while
# scanning, and that goes for an assistant reading it on your behalf.
